results.title: Meal Ticket
results.overview: Follow the untold story of the 47-year old legacy of the McDonald's All American Game and the past, present and future stars that defined it.

results.title: WallDale
results.overview: At first glance, WallDale appears to be an ordinary town, quiet streets, familiar faces, and a reassuring sense of routine. Life moves steadily, shaped by repetition and tradition, where nothing ever truly changes. But beneath the calm exterior lies a fragile balance dependent on everyone playing their part.  When a new arrival disrupts the rhythm of daily life and a violent death shatters the illusion of safety, suspicion spreads quickly. As neighbours turn on one another and secrets surface, it becomes clear that the events unfolding are not random.  The town is part of a far darker experiment, controlled by hidden forces manipulating lives with cold precision. What begins as a search for a killer evolves into a fight for identity, free will, and survival as the terrifying truth behind WallDale is revealed.

results.title: Bruce Springsteen and the E Street Band: Land of Hope and Dreams American Tour (Philadelphia Freedom Cut): Part Three
results.original_title: Bruce Springsteen and the E Street Band: Land of Hope and Dreams American Tour (Philadelphia Freedom Cut): Part Three
results.overview: Bruce Springsteen and The E Street Band have released the third part of their Philadelphia Freedom Cut project, sharing official video of the next eight songs from their Land of Hope and Dreams American Tour finale: “House of a Thousand Guitars," "My City of Ruins," "Because the Night," "Wrecking Ball," "The Rising," "The Ghost of Tom Joad," "Badlands" and "Land of Hope and Dreams."

results.title: Ducobu et le fantôme de Saint-Potache
results.original_title: Ducobu et le fantôme de Saint-Potache
results.overview: It’s Halloween, and Ducobu is back for an adventure filled with laughter and mystery! Professor Latouche and Miss Rateau move into a house haunted by the ghost of Anatole, the biggest dunce in the history of Saint-Potache School. This mischievous ghost will drag Ducobu, Léonie, their parents, and Kitrish into a series of hilarious and unexpected adventures. But beware: on Halloween, anything can happen!

results.title: Landslide
results.overview: Separated from their mother during the chaotic Poso riots, a young boy and his older brother with Down syndrome join forces with a dedicated police officer, forging an unforgettable bond as they navigate deadly conflict to find her.

results.title: Mile End Kicks
results.overview: Grace Pine, a 24-year-old music critic, moves to Montreal to write a book on Alanis Morissette's Jagged Little Pill, but her plans are complicated when she becomes romantically involved with two members of an indie band she is covering and decides to become their publicist.

results.title: AEW Redemption 2026: The Buy In
results.overview: Redemption 2026 was the inaugural edition of All Elite Wrestling's annual Redemption pay-per-view, held on July 26, 2026, at the Bell Centre in Montreal, Quebec, Canada. The event was co-headlined by Kenny Omega (c) vs. Kevin Knight for the AEW World Championship and Thekla (c) vs. Willow Nightingale for the AEW Women's World Championship. This is the pre-show event that aired free before the pay-per-view.

results.title: NJPW Presents CMLL Fantastica Mania 2026 - Day 2
results.original_title: NJPW Presents CMLL Fantastica Mania 2026 - Day 2
results.overview: The second night of Fantastica Mania 2026 was a professional wrestling event co-produced by Japanese promotion New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) and Mexican promotion Consejo Mundial De Lucha Libre (CMLL) that took place on February 21, 2026 at CHRES Gymnasium in Kochi, Japan.

results.title: Deviens génial
results.overview: Mathias is a teacher and has finally been transferred to his daughter’s middle school. But no sooner has he arrived than he learns that his German class is being canceled due to a lack of students. He then decides to organize a trip to Germany to motivate the teens to choose the language, and to fund it, he turns to Iris, the head of the local sister city committee. The catch is that Mathias is a Spanish teacher. Between Mathias, who doesn’t speak a word of German, the frustrated teens, and an irrational Iris, the school trip is shaping up to be utter chaos. Yet nothing will stop him from becoming the father his daughter no longer expects… and to achieve his goal, he’ll have to become awesome!

results.title: Rio de Sangue
results.overview: After leading a failed operation, a policewoman under a death threat leaves São Paulo in search of safety and to reconnect with her daughter, who works as a doctor for a non-governmental organization and was kidnapped in the interior of Pará by illegal gold miners.

results.title: #indie
results.overview: Two friends enter a local filmmaking competition to try and settle their debts.

results.title: Особый пациент
results.overview: Brilliant plastic surgeon Berladin takes on the most challenging case of his career—restoring the face of the disfigured sergeant major, Perkhun. While helping his patient find hope for the future, the doctor unexpectedly encounters his own family secret. These circumstances upend his life, forcing him to radically reassess his past and concepts of goodness and justice. The fates of the surgeon and his patient become inextricably intertwined, and the trials they face force each to choose between duty, love, and the right to start anew.

results.title: Trailer for Dante's "Paradiso"
results.overview: Vintage pornography reels from the archives of Italy’s National Film Museum display over an AI recitation of Dante's The Divine Comedy.

results.title: Until We Meet Again
results.overview: After failing to land a job, Shimizu Misora stumbles into an internship at funeral company Bando Kaikan and trains under the strict but compassionate Urushibara Reiji. As she learns to care for the bereaved, her discouragement turns into admiration, and a new sense of purpose.

results.title: Ivry Who?
results.overview: Paris, 2016. At two in the morning, a young filmmaker in crisis meets his 93-year-old neighbor — the legendary, mercurial violinist Ivry Gitlis. Their unexpected bond ignites a five-year odyssey into the soul of a forgotten genius, to help understand why Ivry was virtually erased from the official records.

results.original_title: Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration
results.overview: Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration at Disneyland Resort brings together the largest gathering of Disney Princess stars ever assembled, celebrating the iconic stories across animation, live-action, stage, and music. This one-of-a-kind concert will transform the night skies with dazzling lights, sweeping projections, and sky-high fountains creating a truly immersive world where the music, magic, and legacy of Disney Princesses shine like never before.

results.title: Final Broadcast
results.overview: During what appears to be the last live television broadcast before a nuclear apocalypse, a host and his crew struggle to keep the show on air as the world outside collapses.

results.title: Carapace
results.overview: When her teenage daughter decides to leave home to study, Maite feels the world she has built begin to fall apart. As the fear of losing her takes hold, a strange presence begins to spread through the house, contaminating both the space and the bond between mother and daughter.
